nimani_qoplaydi.qiymat: O'qish to'lovi, oylik stipendiya (bakalavr 6 500 TL, magistr 9 500 TL), yotoqxona, tibbiy sug'urta, bir martalik aviachipta
nimani_qoplaydi.manba_iborasi: not only inclusive of financial support, tuition fee, accommodation and health insurance

toliq_qoplaydi.manba_iborasi: get a fully funded and, high-quality education

deadline.manba_iborasi: between 10 January and 20 February, which is the application period every year

talablar.qiymat: Darajaga mos yosh, akademik va dastur talablari

qoladigan_xarajat.qiymat: Stipendiya yetarliligi, qoplanmagan kontrakt, boshlang‘ich to‘lov va safarni hisoblang.

majburiyat.qiymat: Renewal, xizmat va birlashtirish shartlari grant xatida tekshirilsin.
